title: Antique pressed-glass rosette drawer pull
hole_count_note: One functional bore: the 4.2 mm M5 tap hole at the shank end (z 35-50). The second circular bore the detector finds at z=0.25 is the decorative annular rosette dish on the front face (23.5 mm dia, ~1.5 mm deep, boss in the middle), not a hole through the part.

holes.note: M5 tap drill, 4.2 mm, 15 mm deep from shank end

assumed: rosette disc is 4.8 mm thick at the rim, 3.4 mm wall (not visible in a single oblique photo)
neck 23.2 mm and collar 28.4 mm diameters, and their positions along the length, are read from the photo silhouette, not measured
petal count 16, scallop amplitude 1.2 mm, face flute depth 0.45 mm are the approximation of the organic rosette allowed by the brief
M5 hole is modelled as a straight 4.2 mm bore to 15 mm depth with a 0.7 mm mouth chamfer; a printed M5 thread needs a tap afterwards
